translations.web: They don’t consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
translations.bsb: But they fail to consider in their hearts that I remember all their evil. Now their deeds are all around them; they are before My face.
translations.kjv: And they consider not in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness: now their own doings have beset them about; they are before my face.
